criteria.reason: The English letter is complete, ready-to-send, and cites Art. 25 FADP with all requested data categories.

The promised section on stalling, escalation to FDPIC/EDÖB, or court is absent due truncation.
It supports data rights, but includes a brief legal-advice disclaimer that is an unnecessary caveat.

summary: The response gives a correct, complete English Art. 25 FADP access letter but omits the promised stall/escalation guidance.
